profile.label: Screened
profile.description: Project-defined annual minimum-support screen; not a validated quality guarantee.
profile.algorithm: Simultaneously remove failing rows and columns; recompute retained-X totals and positive-cell support until no axis fails.
profile.reference: RCA is recomputed from the retained country/activity cohort separately in every domain-year.
profile.positive_support: Count strictly positive raw X cells, not RCA degrees or distinct documents.
profile.selection: No country names, ECI values, ranks, sign directions or spectral gaps enter eligibility.
profile.missing_values: Undefined spectral ECI/ACI remains missing, including disconnected or unseparated modes.
limitations: Annual cohorts can change over time.
Fractional output mass is not a distinct-document count.
Screening does not correct recent filing-year right censoring or source coverage bias.
Threshold and spectral sensitivity can remain after screening.

provenance.reference_population: RCA, ECI/ACI, fitness, proximity and nestedness recomputed within each annual screened country/activity cohort.
provenance.activity_labels: Upstream activity label mappings; Product descriptions are representative HS6 descriptions within each HS4 code.
provenance.nestedness_null_model: Fixed-fixed curveball, preserving row and column degrees; 100 null samples. Empty rows and columns are dropped for nestedness statistics.
provenance.activity_space_method: Recomputed maximum spanning forest plus proximity > 0.55 (Product) or > 0.45 (Technology and Knowledge); Louvain communities. Coordinates regenerated for the latest two years only.
provenance.year_policy: All available years of metrics; latest available year of detailed activity spaces and binary matrices for each dataset.
provenance.missing_values: Non-finite metric values are Parquet nulls. Missing ECI/ACI values are not converted to zero.
provenance.recent_years: Recent-year coverage can be incomplete, particularly patent grant/filing and publication data; latest means latest available, not necessarily complete.
